floor_history.headline: recon: clean pure-C draft 38 -> 3 (s32 c0lo, multi-set lh staging, u16 loads into buf8); last 3 = sched1 lbu placement, mechanism proven (v3b gets exact order, moves residual to a 24-insn RA seat rota

Floor still 3 but the shape is new: every block-1 register seat now matches the target and only the D_800A3916 lbu slot (3 insns) remains; s1's whole 24-insn rotation family is explained by one predic

frontier.hypothesis: The sched1 T-3 stall can be reached by removing the memory-unit blockage rather than by making the ior unready - e.g. by changing what occupies the memory unit at T-2/T-3, or by a spelling in which the D_800A3698 store (insn 48) is the T-3 candidate instead of the ior.
frontier.mechanism: sched.c:1200-1240 actual_hazard_this_instance: a load issued immediately before a store on the memory unit costs max(1, bmax(load)=2 - bmax(store)=1 + 1) = 2 cycles, which is the only reason the flag lbu loses T-3 despite higher INSN_PRIORITY and larger INSN_LUID.
frontier.next_probe: Re-dump with the instrumented cc1 (tools/gcc-2.7.2/cc1) under BB2_RANK_DEBUG=1 to print the T-3 ready list and the rank decisions for insns 58/65/48 on the w3 state, and confirm whether insn 48 is also blocked at T-3; then decide whether an extra block-1 instruction (or one fewer) changes the unit occupancy.

frontier.hypothesis: A block-1 shape in which the value stored to D_800A369C reaches the store through a pseudo distinct from hi16 AND hi16 is not the flag carrier - i.e. a fourth flag-carrier arrangement not covered by the measured trichotomy - could give both the anti-dependence and the a0 seat.
frontier.mechanism: The trichotomy killed this session is exhaustive only for block-1 shapes containing exactly the current instruction set; adding or removing one insn changes both the local-alloc qty landscape (local-alloc.c:1565-1600 find_free_reg order) and the sched1 ready sets.
frontier.next_probe: Run tools/ra_solver/extract.py + inverse.py on the w3 state pinned to block 1 with the goal {packed: v0, hi16: a0, flag: v0} to enumerate which pseudo-count/live-range configurations are REACHABLE, then spell only the reachable ones.

frontier.hypothesis: The buf8 low-half reuse carried since s1 (writing the (u16)D_800A3698 / (u16)D_800A36D0 loads into the existing call-crossing buf8 local) needs its family decided before any candidate-ready submission; the new `flag` local, the in-place ior and the statement ordering are ordinary C and need nothing.
frontier.mechanism: Policy: the reuse is either ordinary scratch-variable C (sibling func_8003A5A0 in the same TU uses the same step-wise scratch idiom) or the staged-value-reused-variable family, which requires a FAKE annotation plus lever exhaustion.
frontier.next_probe: Grep docs/reference/sotn-construct-index.md for a low-half-load-into-an-existing-call-crossing-local precedent before writing self_vet.md; if the census is negative, emit ruling-request rather than a submission.
